definitions.explanation: The act of providing water to plants, flowers, or gardens.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{花|はな}に{水|みず}やりをする。
examples.english: I water the flowers every morning.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}やりを{忘|わす}れて{植物|しょくぶつ}が{枯|か}れてしまった。
examples.english: I forgot to water and the plant withered.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{水|みず}やりの{回数|かいすう}を{増|ふ}やす。
examples.english: In summer, increase the frequency of watering.

notes:
{水|みず}やり refers to watering plants.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水|みず}やりをする (to water plants)
- {水|みず}をやる (to give water to)
- {水|みず}をあげる (to give water - more casual)

WATERING TIPS:
- {朝|あさ}か{夕方|ゆうがた}にやる (water in the morning or evening)
- {土|つち}が{乾|かわ}いたらやる (water when the soil is dry)
- {根元|ねもと}にやる (water at the base)

TOOLS:
- じょうろ (watering can)
- ホース (garden hose)
- スプレー (spray bottle)

RELATED GARDENING ACTIVITIES:
- {剪定|せんてい} (pruning)
- {種|たね}まき (sowing seeds)
- {植|う}え{替|か}え (repotting)
